scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm -w @vo/shared run dev" "npm -w @vo/server run dev" "npm -w @vo/client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @vo/shared run build && npm -w @vo/server run build && npm -w @vo/client run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
